newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares gain on bargain-hunting to end up.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares gain on bargain-hunting to end up.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key industrial index rose 20.52 points to 10,327.50 on Thursday, its second consecutive climb, attributed by some brokers to demand for some select heavy-weight counters and bargain-hunting.
"There was a combination of the quality searchers and the bargain hunters today, and those two swung and kept the index up," one broker commented, adding the market remained largely mixed in outlook.
Counters to gain included Zimbabwe Sugar Refinery, up 50 cents at 1,450, seed company SeedCo, which traded 15 cents higher at 275, hotel group ZIMSUN, 10 cents firmer at 390.
The secondary seven-share mining index jumped 54.46 points 993.70 on the back of a 50-cent rise in nickel producer Bindura at 750 and gold giant Rio Tinto which lept 300 cents to 2,600.
